meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Hostinger vs Bluehost: Price, Renewals and Offers (2026)
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Hostinger vs Bluehost compared on sale and renewal prices, sites, AI tools, Black Friday offers and independent tests from All About Cookies and Gizmodo.
meta.rl_answer: Hostinger is cheaper to start and lists more AI tools. Bluehost is cheaper to keep and has more sites on the entry plan.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Hostinger better than Bluehost? | Hostinger is cheaper to start and lists more AI tools. Bluehost is cheaper to keep and has more sites on the entry plan.
Which is cheaper, Hostinger or Bluehost? | Hostinger Premium is $1.99 a month and renews at $10.99. Bluehost Starter is $3.99 and renews at $9.99.
Does Bluehost have a Black Friday sale? | Yes: 15% off one product, 20% off two or 25% off three or more, first 12-month term only, to 30 November 2026.
Which has more sites on the entry plan? | Bluehost Starter lists 10 sites. Hostinger Premium lists 3.
Do both offer a money-back guarantee? | Both list a 30-day money-back guarantee.

meta.rl_takeaways:
Hostinger Premium is $1.99 a month and Bluehost Starter is $3.99.
Bluehost renews lower: $9.99 against $10.99.
Bluehost's offer ends 30 November. Hostinger's ends 14 December.
The independent tests used different methods.
